stimulus.title: Hội thoại giữa hai đồng nghiệp
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Hi, Daniel. I just heard the printer on the second floor is broken again. Do you know if anyone has called the repair service?
Man: I called them this morning. Unfortunately, they said a technician can't come until Thursday.
Woman: Thursday? I need two hundred copies of the training manual for tomorrow's workshop.
Man: Why don't you use the copy center across the street? They're fast, and the company has an account there, so you won't have to pay for it yourself.
Woman: That's a great idea. I'll send them the file right now.

questions.stem_html: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explain_html: Ngay câu đầu, người phụ nữ nói the printer on the second floor is broken again. Đáp án diễn đạt lại thành is not working, một kiểu paraphrase rất phổ biến ở Part 3.

questions.stem_html: According to the man, when will a technician come?
questions.explain_html: a technician can't come until Thursday, tức là sớm nhất thứ Năm. This morning là lúc anh ấy gọi điện (bẫy); tomorrow là ngày diễn ra workshop.

questions.stem_html: What will the woman most likely do next?

options.label: B
options.html: Send a file to a copy center

questions.explain_html: Câu hỏi do next thường có đáp án ở câu cuối: I'll send them the file right now, với them là copy center. Công ty đã có account nên (D) sai.

questions.stem_html: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

options.label: B
options.html: The cost of a training course

options.label: C
options.html: Changing the time of a meeting

questions.explain_html: Ngay câu đầu: khách hàng muốn move our meeting from Wednesday to Thursday, tức là đổi lịch họp.

questions.stem_html: Why is the man unavailable on Thursday morning?

options.label: A
options.html: He will be meeting another client.

options.label: C
options.html: He will be preparing a report.

options.label: D
options.html: He will be attending a training session.

questions.explain_html: Thursday morning I'm at the safety training. Đáp án paraphrase thành attending a training session.

questions.stem_html: What does the man ask the woman to do?

options.label: A
options.html: Ask a coworker to bring some figures

questions.explain_html: could you ask Jenny to bring the latest sales figures? Jenny là đồng nghiệp, nên đáp án viết thành a coworker.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại giữa hai đồng nghiệp
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Kevin, the people from Brightline Foods just called. They'd like to move our meeting from Wednesday to Thursday. Would that work for you?
Man: Thursday morning I'm at the safety training all morning, but I'm free after lunch.
Woman: Then let's say two o'clock. I'll book conference room five.
Man: Sounds good. And could you ask Jenny to bring the latest sales figures? They'll probably want to see them.
Woman: Sure, I'll send her a message now.

questions.stem_html: What problem does the man report?

options.label: A
options.html: His room key does not work.

questions.explain_html: the air conditioner doesn't seem to be working.

questions.stem_html: Why can't the problem be fixed immediately?

options.label: B
options.html: Maintenance staff are not working now.

questions.explain_html: Our maintenance staff have gone home for the night: nhân viên kỹ thuật đã về.

questions.stem_html: What does the woman offer to do?

options.label: B
options.html: Call a taxi for the man

options.label: C
options.html: Move the man to a different room

questions.explain_html: I can move you there at no extra charge: chuyển sang phòng suite ở tầng 9.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại tại quầy lễ tân khách sạn
stimulus.audio_script:
Man: Good evening. I'm in room 512, and the air conditioner doesn't seem to be working. It's really warm in there.
Woman: I'm very sorry about that, sir. Our maintenance staff have gone home for the night, so it can't be repaired until tomorrow morning.
Man: Oh, that's a problem. I have an early meeting and I need to get some sleep.
Woman: I understand. We have a suite available on the ninth floor. I can move you there at no extra charge, and someone will help you with your luggage.
Man: That would be great. Thank you.

questions.stem_html: Why is the woman calling?

options.label: A
options.html: To complain about a late delivery

options.label: B
options.html: To ask about a job opening

questions.explain_html: Người phụ nữ gọi để order lunch for a training day.

questions.stem_html: Why will the woman not pay for delivery?

options.label: B
options.html: She will pick up the food herself.

options.label: C
options.html: Her order is above a certain amount.

questions.explain_html: since your order is over two hundred dollars, delivery is free: đơn trên một mức tiền nhất định.

questions.stem_html: What will the man send this afternoon?
questions.explain_html: I'll e-mail you a confirmation this afternoon.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại qua điện thoại với công ty cung cấp suất ăn
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Hello, this is Sandra from Pellman Architects. I'd like to order lunch for a training day next Friday. There'll be about thirty people.
Man: Certainly. Would you like our sandwich platters or hot meals?
Woman: Sandwich platters, please. But around ten of the participants are vegetarian.
Man: No problem. We'll include a vegetarian platter. And since your order is over two hundred dollars, delivery is free.
Woman: Great. Could you deliver it by eleven thirty? The break starts at noon.
Man: Of course. I'll e-mail you a confirmation this afternoon.

questions.stem_html: What does the man want to know?

options.label: A
options.html: How to book a business trip

options.label: C
options.html: How to get money back for expenses

questions.explain_html: I'm not sure how to get reimbursed for my travel expenses. reimbursed = được hoàn tiền.

questions.stem_html: What problem does the man mention?

options.label: C
options.html: He cannot log in to a portal.

questions.explain_html: What if I lost one of the receipts? I can't find my taxi receipt.

options.label: B
options.html: Take a taxi to the airport

questions.explain_html: I'll talk to Mr. Hayes this afternoon. Mr. Hayes là quản lý, người phải ký vào bản giải trình.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại giữa nhân viên mới và đồng nghiệp
stimulus.audio_script:
Man: Hi, Grace. I just got back from my first business trip, and I'm not sure how to get reimbursed for my travel expenses.
Woman: It's all done online now. You log in to the company portal, fill in the expense form, and upload pictures of your receipts.
Man: What if I lost one of the receipts? I can't find my taxi receipt from the airport.
Woman: In that case, you'll need to write a short explanation and have your manager sign it.
Man: OK, I'll talk to Mr. Hayes this afternoon.

questions.stem_html: What position are the applicants applying for?
questions.explain_html: the applicants for the accounting position. Đây là vị trí kế toán; audit chỉ là lý do tuần sau bận.

questions.stem_html: Why is next week busy for the man?
questions.explain_html: Next week is busy because of the audit.

questions.stem_html: What does the man ask the woman to send him?
questions.explain_html: please send me their résumés before the weekend.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại về việc sắp xếp phỏng vấn
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Mr. Lindqvist, I've narrowed the applicants for the accounting position down to three. When would you like to interview them?
Man: Next week is busy because of the audit. Could we do all three interviews on Monday the fourteenth?
Woman: That should be possible. I'll contact them today. Would you like me to schedule them in the morning?
Man: Yes, starting at nine, with an hour for each candidate. And please send me their résumés before the weekend.

questions.stem_html: Where most likely are the speakers?

options.label: A

options.label: D
options.html: A car needs to be repaired.

questions.explain_html: all our compact cars were returned late today, so none are ready: loại xe đã đặt không có sẵn.

questions.explain_html: Is it difficult to park a midsize car downtown?, tức là lo chuyện đỗ xe ở trung tâm.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại tại quầy thuê xe
stimulus.audio_script:
Man: Hi, I have a reservation for a compact car under the name Moreau.
Woman: Let me see... Yes, Mr. Moreau. I'm afraid all our compact cars were returned late today, so none are ready. But I can give you a midsize car for the same price.
Man: That's fine. Is it difficult to park a midsize car downtown?
Woman: Not really. And the hotels downtown all have parking garages. Here's the key. The car is in space twenty-three, just outside that door.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại về việc chọn phòng cho buổi hội thảo
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Pablo, we need a room for the customer service workshop on the twentieth. We're expecting about forty people.
Man: Let me check the list. Room 101 is too small, and the auditorium is much too big for forty.
Woman: What about the other two?
Man: Both are big enough, but we'll need a projector, and only one of them has one. I'll reserve that one.
Woman: Perfect. I'll let the participants know.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại tại cửa hàng điện tử
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Hi, I bought these headphones here last week, but the left side stopped working. I'd like to return them.
Man: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
Woman: Unfortunately, no. I think I threw it away.
Man: Without a receipt, I can't give you a cash refund, but I can exchange them for a new pair or give you store credit.
Woman: A new pair would be fine. I like this model.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại về báo cáo cuối quý
stimulus.audio_script:
Man: Rita, are you going to be able to finish the quarterly report by Friday?
Woman: I'm trying, but I'm still waiting for the figures from the Madrid office. They said they'd send them on Monday, and they still haven't.
Man: Hmm. Mr. Watanabe needs the report for the board meeting next Tuesday.
Woman: Well, I've got their manager's direct number.
Man: Good. If you still don't have the data by Thursday, let me know and I'll ask for a short extension.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại tại bưu cục
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Hi, I need to send this package to our client in Busan. It contains some product samples.
Man: Sure. How quickly does it need to get there?
Woman: It has to arrive by Thursday, but I'd like to keep the cost as low as possible.
Man: Today's Monday, so the cheapest option that arrives by Thursday is this one. Would you like to add insurance?
Woman: No, thanks. The samples aren't valuable.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại về việc chuyển văn phòng
stimulus.audio_script:
Man: Hi, Lena. Is everything ready for the move to the new office this weekend?
Woman: Almost. The moving company is coming at eight on Saturday. Everyone has to pack their desks by Friday at five.
Man: What about the computers? I'm worried about losing data.
Woman: The IT team will disconnect and pack all the computers themselves on Friday evening. They'll also back up all the files first.
Man: That's a relief. I'll start packing my desk this afternoon, then.

options.label: C

questions.explain_html: let us know your choices by Thursday: gửi lựa chọn món.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại đặt bàn nhà hàng
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Good afternoon, Harbor View Restaurant.
Man: Hi. I'd like to book a table for twelve people this Saturday evening for my company's anniversary dinner.
Woman: For a group that size, we recommend our private dining room. It has a view of the harbor, but there's a minimum charge of five hundred dollars.
Man: That should be fine. Can we choose the menu in advance?
Woman: Yes, I'll e-mail you our group menu, and you can let us know your choices by Thursday.

options.label: B
options.html: The results of an advertising campaign

questions.explain_html: the results of our spring advertising campaign.

options.label: D
options.html: Social media brought in most new customers.

questions.explain_html: Quảng cáo TV tốn nhiều nhất, nhưng most new customers said they found us through social media.

questions.stem_html: What will the man do on Monday?
questions.explain_html: I'll prepare a proposal … and present it at Monday's meeting.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại về kết quả chiến dịch quảng cáo
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Have you seen the results of our spring advertising campaign?
Man: Yes, I was surprised. The TV ads cost the most, but most new customers said they found us through social media.
Woman: Interesting. So maybe we should spend more on social media for the summer campaign.
Man: I agree. I'll prepare a proposal with a new budget and present it at Monday's meeting.

stimulus.title: Hội thoại tại ga tàu
stimulus.audio_script:
Man: Excuse me, I need to get to Westfield for a meeting at eleven. Which train should I take?
Woman: Let me see. It's ten past nine now. The journey takes about an hour and a half.
Man: So I should take the earliest one I can, then.
Woman: Yes, but the nine fifteen train is already full today. You'll have to take the next one.
Man: OK. That still gives me enough time. Thanks.
